cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: Billy, for Christ's sakes, you must be committed, right?

cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: You ought to be out in the convertible Well,

cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: What are you doing here, for Christ's sake?

cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: Jesus, I mean, you guys do nothing but complain about how you can't stand it in this place here, and then you haven't got the guts just to walk out.

cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: I mean, what do you think you are, for Christ's sake, crazy or something?

cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: You're no crazier than the average asshole out walking around on the streets, and that's it.

cues.speaker: mcmurphy
cues.text: Jesus Christ, I can't even believe it.
